_comment: The current chapter is the last one whose 'starts' flag is held and whose 'ends' flag is not. All flags are saved world flags, so story progress persists with no extra tables.

chapters.title: A WORLD OF NUMBERS
chapters.objective: Talk to Professor Numeris in the village square.
chapters.summary: A new Numera Trainer arrives in Starter Village and meets Professor Numeris. The Counting Stone flickers - and far away, the old arch in the ruins pulses purple.

chapters.title: THE FORGOTTEN NUMBERS
chapters.objective: Investigate the Ancient Number Ruins and restore the three Numera Seals.
chapters.summary: MathMon in the Green Meadow behave strangely. Tallyfolk stones speak of a 'Remainder', and the ruins' seals bear fresh scratches. The Arithmetic Beast is freed - while a hooded stranger watches.
chapters.ending: The Arithmetic Beast fell. A hooded stranger watched from the arch - and a cave opened beneath the ruins.

chapters.title: THE FRACTURED EQUATIONS
chapters.objective: Explore the Algebra Cavern and free its guardian.
chapters.summary: The Order of the Unknown stored Numera inside equations. Their lost laboratory holds notes about two researchers, 'N.' and 'V.', who reopened the Remainder vault twenty years ago.
chapters.ending: The Unknown Guardian was freed. The stranger is collecting the Remainder from every guardian - on purpose.

chapters.title: THE BROKEN DIMENSIONS
chapters.objective: Cross Euclidia to the Dragon Keep and free the Dimension Dragon.
chapters.summary: Euclidia's chronicles say the Unravelling was caused by the ancients' own calculation - not natural decay, as the Professor said. A burnt log in the Keep is in his handwriting.
chapters.ending: The Dimension Dragon fell. One guardian remains - and so do the Professor's secrets.

chapters.title: THE ORIGIN OF CHAOS
chapters.objective: Climb the Time Spire. Find out who the stranger is - and what the Professor did.
chapters.summary: Time has stopped at 3:14. The stranger is Vera Tallow, the Professor's former partner. Twenty years ago their experiment on the Origin Engine froze her village.
chapters.ending: The Infinite Overlord fell, and the way to the Zero Point opened.

chapters.title: THE LAST CALCULATION
chapters.objective: Face Vera at the Origin Engine beneath the Time Spire.
chapters.summary: At the Zero Point, Vera begins the Last Calculation: a world with no remainder, no mistakes - and no change.
chapters.ending: The Last Calculation ended. Mathea still has its remainder - and its future.

chapters.title: WHAT REMAINS
chapters.objective: Explore Mathea freely. Talk to old friends.
chapters.summary: The Numera flows again. There are still MathMon to meet, records to read and questions to solve.
